The chemical smell that hit me upon unboxing was overwhelming and took a full week to dissipate. I had high hopes for comfort, but this mattress offers zero support, feeling more like sinking into a pit of warm quicksand. My partner and I both started waking up with terrible lower back pain that we never had before. This thing also traps body heat like a personal sauna, leaving me sweating every single night.

Don't even think about sitting on the side of the bed, as the non-existent edge support will send you sliding to the floor. After just two months, a permanent, body-shaped crater has formed that makes rolling over a genuine struggle. The hassle of trying to return this giant, disappointing foam rectangle is a nightmare in itself. Do yourself a favor and save your money, because this mattress has been a complete waste.
